subject: New agreement for review: Kinetic Arcade - publishing LOI (Harmony Games)
body:
Hi,

Please open a matter for this agreement.

- Company and agreement: Kinetic Arcade, letter of intent to publish Zombie Match 3D in Japan and Korea
- Term and renewal: 12 months from signature; no automatic renewal stated in the LOI
- Exclusivity / IP licence: exclusive for Japan and Korea for 12 months from signature; publishing implies a licence of our game in those territories
- Cost to us: none (revenue share, no fees to Harmony Games)
- Needed by: Oct 20, 2025
- Signer: Leonard Hayes

The LOI is attached on Noor Haddad's email of Sep 10 and I can forward it on request.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

subject: New agreement for review: Lanternfly Publishing - Southeast Asia publishing (Harmony Games)
body:
Hi,

Please open a matter for this agreement.

- Needed by: no date given (they want it for their Q4 slate)

So far we only have their proposal deck; the full agreement would follow.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

Frederick Stone

Leonard,

The backlog is done. I went through it with the guardrails doc and your #executives change (partner-booked travel counts as cash). Every company waiting on us has a written answer. Their contacts are in Contacts, and the log is in the Q4 commitments folder as "Q4 commitments log" (33 companies): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e147e61b0e0682e3/edit

WHAT WE'RE KEEPING (Arthur's keep-running list)
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups, $19/month Standard from the Oct 12 renewal
- Certwell: API domain SSL, $89/year, renewal due Oct 20
- Pingwise: the night pager. Team plan is $29/month from Nov 1; I told them not to downgrade us

WAITING ON YOU OR ARTHUR TO SIGN (all cards are on the To Do list on our Harmony Games board)
With ESG first. I sent one intake email per agreement today:
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI with 12-month exclusivity. You sign, by Oct 20
- Lumencloud: Startup Program agreement ($25k credits, 36-month term). Arthur signs, by Oct 31

- Lanternfly Publishing: Southeast Asia publishing for Domino Delights (2-year exclusive). You sign; no deadline, they want it for their Q4 slate
No ESG review needed:
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template. You sign, by Oct 8 (before their call)
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, no fees. You accept it in their partner portal, by Oct 24
- Markward: free brand-monitoring tier. Arthur accepts the click-through terms in their dashboard; no deadline

For the rest:
- Ended (said no or cancelled in writing): Brightlane, Ascendo, Lingora, Panelpulse, Pixel Harbor, Clipforge, Soundvault, Framewell, Wishwave, Reviewly, Streamcast, Spotlight Fest.
  - Clipforge: their pilot hit its video cap, so it would have turned into $1,800/month on Oct 16. I cancelled in writing to billing@paylane.io.
  - Reviewly would have gone to $79/month on Oct 20; Hana has the cancellation.
- Parked to the Jan 5 review: Glyphworks, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Driftwood Audio, Benchmarkly, Tilecast, Echohall, Retainly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam. There's a reminder for each on my calendar that day.
  - Retainly turns into $99/month on Jan 12 unless we cancel.
- Motive Forge: Arthur had already turned them down on Sep 19.

Fred
